# Copilot Instructions

This project is a Next.js medrese website with Prisma and PostgreSQL.

Do not commit secrets or local environment files.

- Keep .env and .env.local uncommitted.
- Use local PostgreSQL for data features.
- Prefer the existing app-router structure.
- Validate with `npx tsc --noEmit` after meaningful changes.
- Use `npm run dev` for local work and keep the app on http://localhost:3002.
- Respect the existing admin/student registration flow.
- Do not replace real data with placeholder values.
- Keep code consistent with current project conventions.
